question: Does the sole zero-row-selected positive-Ember-overflow to Heavy Blow representation preserve exact current-main at omission and explicit off, preserve every mechanistic negative control at on, and isolate its producer, non-stacking private mediator, exact consumer, fixed payoff, comparator and lifecycle under direct A/B/AB controls?
hypothesis: For Duskblade only, a positive post-quest Ember request whose realised clamp delta is smaller than the request can set one non-stacking combat-private mark. A later exact Heavy Blow in the same player turn consumes that mark and adds exactly three damage to its sole ordinary hit and preview. The mark otherwise expires at end turn, victory or loss.
claimBoundary: Source, interface, direct A/B/AB, call-cardinality, comparator, exact-null and intended-mediator identity only. No natural support, capacity, policy choice, causal endpoint, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim.

emberOverflowHeavyBlow.enabled: For Duskblade only, after quest adjustment and before the unchanged Ember event, a positive gain_embers request with requested minus realised delta greater than zero sets one non-stacking private mark if none is set. A later exact heavyBlow play in the same player turn consumes it and adds three to the card's sole ordinary hit and preview.
emberOverflowHeavyBlow.producerMagnitude: Any positive discarded amount sets exactly one bit. Discarded magnitude, gain source and repeated overflow while marked cannot scale or stack the mediator.
emberOverflowHeavyBlow.lifecycle: Combat-private; expires unused at end turn, victory or loss and is omitted from the product projection and save surface.

emberOverflowHeavyBlow by action order: Heavy Blow must follow overflow in the same player turn; before-overflow and next-turn Heavy Blow are payoff-null.
emberOverflowHeavyBlow by consumer identity: exact heavyBlow consumes; defend and twinFangs leave the mark to expire.
emberOverflowHeavyBlow by lifecycle boundary: end turn, victory and loss clear an unused mark.
emberOverflowHeavyBlow by upgrade and target Ward: the fixed increment remains three for base, upgraded and blocked Heavy Blow; no scaling or threshold is introduced.
